sources.name: ICTV Arenaviridae
sources.evidence_statement: ICTV separates mammarenaviruses from reptarenaviruses, hartmaniviruses and antennaviruses; human disease is concentrated in mammarenaviruses.

sources.name: ViralZone Mammarenavirus
sources.evidence_statement: ViralZone lists mammarenavirus members and reference viruses, supporting the human-relevant mammarenavirus scope and separation from reptarenaviruses and other arenavirus genera.
